import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;
    static int n, m;
    static long[][] a;
    static long[] cnt = new long[1 << 20];
    static long[] cnt2 = new long[1 << 20];
    static int[] rev = new int[1 << 20];
    static int[] rev2 = new int[1 << 20];

    static long modpow(long x, long n) {
        long res = 1;
        while (n > 0) {
            if ((n & 1) == 1) res = res * x % MOD;
            x = x * x % MOD;
            n >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    // Check if there exists a permutation of indices such that for each x, con[x] has bit indices[x] set.
    static boolean hasPermutation(int[] con, int len, int[] indices) {
        // indices are sorted initially, we generate all permutations recursively
        return permute(con, len, indices, 0);
    }

    static boolean permute(int[] con, int len, int[] indices, int start) {
        if (start == len) {
            // check condition
            for (int x = 0; x < len; x++) {
                if ((con[x] >> indices[x] & 1) == 0) return false;
            }
            return true;
        }
        for (int i = start; i < len; i++) {
            swap(indices, start, i);
            if (permute(con, len, indices, start + 1)) {
                swap(indices, start, i); // backtrack
                return true;
            }
            swap(indices, start, i); // backtrack
        }
        return false;
    }

    static void swap(int[] arr, int i, int j) {
        int tmp = arr[i];
        arr[i] = arr[j];
        arr[j] = tmp;
    }

    static void dfs(int cur, int[] con, int len, long prob) {
        if (cur == m) {
            int nxt = 0, id = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << n); j++) {
                if (Integer.bitCount(j) != m) continue;
                // build list of indices from j
                int[] vi = new int[m];
                int idx = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if ((j >> i & 1) == 1) vi[idx++] = i;
                }
                // check if any permutation works
                if (hasPermutation(con, m, vi)) {
                    id |= (1 << nxt);
                }
                nxt++;
            }
            cnt[id] = (cnt[id] + prob) % MOD;
            return;
        }
        for (int j = 0; j < (1 << n); j++) {
            con[len] = j;
            long nw = prob;
            for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                if ((j >> k & 1) == 1) {
                    nw = nw * a[cur][k] % MOD;
                } else {
                    nw = nw * (MOD + 1 - a[cur][k]) % MOD;
                }
            }
            dfs(cur + 1, con, len + 1, nw);
        }
    }

    static void dfs2(int cur, int[] con, int len, long prob) {
        if (cur == n) {
            int nxt = 0, id = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << n); j++) {
                if (Integer.bitCount(j) != n - m) continue;
                int[] vi = new int[n - m];
                int idx = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if ((j >> i & 1) == 1) vi[idx++] = i;
                }
                if (hasPermutation(con, n - m, vi)) {
                    id |= (1 << nxt);
                }
                nxt++;
            }
            cnt2[id] = (cnt2[id] + prob) % MOD;
            return;
        }
        for (int j = 0; j < (1 << n); j++) {
            con[len] = j;
            long nw = prob;
            for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                if ((j >> k & 1) == 1) {
                    nw = nw * a[cur][k] % MOD;
                } else {
                    nw = nw * (MOD + 1 - a[cur][k]) % MOD;
                }
            }
            dfs2(cur + 1, con, len + 1, nw);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        a = new long[n][n];
        long inv100 = modpow(100, MOD - 2);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                long val = sc.nextLong();
                a[i][j] = val * inv100 % MOD;
                a[i][j] = (a[i][j] % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
            }
        }
        if (n == 1) {
            System.out.println(a[0][0]);
            return;
        }
        m = n / 2;
        // dfs
        int[] con = new int[m];
        dfs(0, con, 0, 1);
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 20); i++) cnt[i] %= MOD;
        // SOS DP on cnt
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << 20); j++) {
                if ((j >> i & 1) == 1) {
                    cnt[j] = (cnt[j] + cnt[j ^ (1 << i)]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
        long all = cnt[(1 << 20) - 1];
        // dfs2
        int[] con2 = new int[n - m];
        dfs2(m, con2, 0, 1);
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 20); i++) cnt2[i] %= MOD;
        // build rev mapping for masks with popcount m
        Arrays.fill(rev, -1);
        int nd = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); i++) {
            if (Integer.bitCount(i) == m) {
                rev[i] = nd++;
            }
        }
        // build rev2 and cor for masks with popcount n-m
        Arrays.fill(rev2, -1);
        nd = 0;
        int[] cor = new int[1 << n]; // allocate enough, will be trimmed later
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); i++) {
            if (Integer.bitCount(i) == n - m) {
                cor[nd] = rev[(1 << n) - 1 - i];
                rev2[i] = nd++;
            }
        }
        // trim cor to actual size
        int[] corTrimmed = Arrays.copyOf(cor, nd);
        long ans = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << nd); i++) {
            long cur = cnt2[i];
            int mask = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < nd; j++) {
                if ((i >> j & 1) == 0) {
                    mask += (1 << corTrimmed[j]);
                }
            }
            ans = (ans + cur * (all - cnt[mask]) % MOD) % MOD;
        }
        ans = (ans % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
